name: kodo_agent_critic
notes:
SubAgentSpec for `agent_critic` — Agent Builder's reviewer (doc/AGENT_BUILDER.md §5.3).

A standalone sub-agent, deliberately not a `role: critic`: a Kōdo critic reviews a work product inside an engine-driven author loop and reports through the findings backlog, while this one is called directly — by `kodo_agent_builder` after each written agent, and by `kodo_agent_review` for the Settings panel's "Review with AI" — and returns its verdict to the caller. Its output is therefore a raw schema rather than `critic_output`. Each concern carries the quote it objects to, so a reviewer can be checked against the files.

instructions.description: What the agent is meant to do: its single purpose, its inputs and outputs, and its place in a pipeline. Empty when unknown — the review then checks the rules alone.

name.description: The agent to review, exactly as list_agents names it.

concerns.description: One entry per problem, in file order; empty when accepted.

rule.description: A lint rule ID (`L4 purpose`), `load`, `intent`, or `<skill name>: <section heading>`.

quote.description: The exact text objected to, copied from the file; empty only for something missing.

location.description: `<file name>:<line>`, `<file name>: <key>` for JSON, or `## <section>` for a missing section.

fix.description: The change that resolves the concern, as a definite instruction.

summary.description: One line: the verdict and the number of concerns.
